land.text: the 'rump state of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom' left around Altava after Garmul's defeat in 578; 'significantly smaller in size'

predecessors.note: Infobox: 'Collapse of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom: 578'. The Mauro-Roman Kingdom page gives 429 for its independence and 'until roughly 589-599' for its decline; it needs a dossier.

land.text: Altava and its surroundings, 'Annexed by Umayyad Caliphate: 708' (infobox)

successors.note: Resistance had passed to the Jerawa of the Aures after Kusaila's death in 690.

capitals.name: Altava (Ouled Mimoun)
capitals.note: Infobox 'Capital: Altava'; the page gives no coordinates, those of Ouled Mimoun are approximate. Kusaila's own base is 'Tlemcen or more probably Tubna' on the Muslim conquest page.

correction.text: the rump kingdom around Altava in western Algeria, after the collapse of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The page says the kingdom was 'significantly smaller in size' after Garmul's collapse and gives no area or frontier; the Oranais region (43,700 km2) is my reading of a kingdom whose capital is Altava (Tlemcen province).

correction.text: 'from Volubilis in the west to the Aures' under the king Aksel (Kusaila): Volubilis, western Algeria, the Algiers region and Numidia up to, but not including, the Aures (the Aures belong to the independent Kingdom of the Aures)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The page says 'During Aksel's reign, the kingdom extended from Volubilis in the west to the Aures' without dating the extension; 678 is the reign start in the infobox's list (Caecilius 678-688, the table gives 680-690). The shape is a union of named regions along that line, not a drawn frontier.

correction.text: the same, plus Kairouan and 'the interior of Ifriqiya' after Uqba's death at Vescera, when Kusaila 'forced the Arabs to leave Kairouan'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. Kairouan held 683 to its recapture in 688 (Uqba page). The page does not say Kusaila 'ruled' Kairouan; the 150 km circle around it is my reading of 'Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya'.

correction.text: the Volubilis-to-Aures band without Kairouan, which the Arabs recaptured in 688

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The Uqba page: the Arab army 'evacuated Kairouan and withdrew to Barca, though it was recaptured in 688'.

correction.text: Altava's core in western Algeria, after Kusaila's death at Mamma in 690 until the 708 annexation

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The page is silent on what the kingdom held between Kusaila's death (690) and 708: the Jerawa resistance in the Aures is the kingdom-of-the-aures dossier; the rest of the band I reduce to the core (the lost land goes to nobody). Confidence 1.

region.text: the rump around Altava (Tlemcen), the capital of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom

ledger.note: 578: the Mauro-Roman Kingdom collapses and Altava remains. Infobox 'Collapse of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom: 578' and 'Rump state of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom'; the Mauro-Roman page: Garmul, who raided from the late 560s, 'was defeated and killed in 578 AD' after a campaign of 577-78.

region.text: from Volubilis in the west to the Aures: western Morocco around Volubilis, the Oranais, Algiers and Numidia

ledger.note: c.678-690: under Aksel (Kusaila) the kingdom reaches from Volubilis to the Aures. 'During Aksel's reign, the kingdom extended from Volubilis in the west to the Aures'; the page gives no year, 678 is the infobox's start of Caecilius's reign (the text names Kusaila/Aksel as the last ruler, d. 690).

region.text: Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya

ledger.note: 683: Uqba dies at Vescera and the Arabs leave Kairouan. 'Uqba ibn Nafi was ambushed and killed in the Battle of Vescera' near Biskra by Kusaila, 'who forced the Arabs to leave Kairouan'; the kingdom later extended 'to Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya'.

region.text: Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya

ledger.note: 688: the Arabs recapture Kairouan. The Uqba page: the army 'evacuated Kairouan and withdrew to Barca, though it was recaptured in 688'; Zuhayr ibn Qays arrives with reinforcements (Altava page).

region.text: Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya, the ground between Kairouan and the Aures

ledger.note: 688: Zuhayr ibn Qays marches against Kusaila. 'In 688 Arab reinforcements under Zuhair ibn Kays arrived'; the Muslim conquest page dates the same advance to 688/9.

region.text: Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya, the ground between Kairouan and the Aures

ledger.note: 690: Kusaila falls at the Battle of Mamma. 'Caecilius met them at the Battle of Mamma, with Byzantine support. The Berbers were outnumbered and defeated, and Caecilius was killed'; he 'died in the year 690 AD'.

region.text: the Volubilis-to-Aures band outside Altava's core: Volubilis, the Algiers region and Numidia west of the Aures, page silent

ledger.note: 690: Kusaila's realm falls apart after Mamma. 'Resistance passed to the Jerawa tribe in the Aures Mountains'; his troops later fought under the Kahina. The page says nothing about who held the land between Altava and the Aures, so it is given to nobody until the Kahina's state of 698 (kingdom-of-the-aures).

region.text: Altava and its surroundings, the kingdom's core

ledger.note: 708: the Umayyads annex Altava. Infobox 'Annexed by Umayyad Caliphate: 708'; the Muslim conquest page has Musa ibn Nusayr garrisoning Tangier 'in 708' and the last Byzantine strongholds falling in 709.

wars.name: Battle of Vescera

zones.text: Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya

wars.outcome: Kusaila ambushed and killed Uqba ibn Nafi near Biskra and 'forced the Arabs to leave Kairouan', which he held until its recapture in 688.
wars.note: The Exarchate page dates Vescera to 682; the Altava and Uqba pages say 683.

wars.name: Battle of Mamma and the Arab reconquest of Ifriqiya

zones.text: Kairouan and the interior of Ifriqiya

wars.outcome: Zuhayr ibn Qays recaptured Kairouan in 688 and defeated a combined Berber and Byzantine army at Mamma in 690, killing Kusaila.
wars.note: The Muslim conquest page dates Zuhayr's march to 688/9 without a year for Mamma; the Aures page and the Mauro-Roman page give 690 for Mamma.

wars.name: Umayyad conquest of the Maghreb (Altava)
wars.outcome: Altava is 'Annexed by Umayyad Caliphate: 708' (infobox); the Muslim conquest page has Tangier garrisoned in 708 and the last Byzantine strongholds lost in 709.
wars.note: The page does not describe any campaign against Altava itself after 690; the 708 date is the infobox's.

certainty.note: A Berber-Roman kingdom of the Algerian highlands: no page gives a frontier; the 678-690 extent 'from Volubilis to the Aures' is a line between two named places.

notes: Cliopatria has no Altava, Aures or Mauro-Roman row. This dossier starts at the 578 collapse of the Mauro-Roman Kingdom, which needs a dossier of its own (429 independence per the infobox, Masuna's inscription at Altava dated 508, Garmul to 578; the page says the Kingdom of Ouarsenis and the Kingdom of Hodna were its regional successors, which no page here dates). Rulers: the infobox gives Sekerdid 668-678 and Caecilius (Kusaila, Aksel) 678-688, the table 680-690, the text his death in 690; no ruler strip is entered because the pages conflict and the first 90 years are unlisted. Kusaila's capital is Altava on this page, 'Tlemcen or more probably Tubna' on the Muslim conquest page. Kairouan: the Altava page says only that Kusaila forced the Arabs out of Kairouan in 683; the Uqba page has the recapture in 688. The Volubilis-to-Aures extent has no date on the page. The Exarchate of Africa (separate dossier) and the Aures kingdom are the neighbours. Gazetteer: Oranais, Volubilis, Algiers, Qairouan, Numidia and the Batna and Khenchela provinces resolve; 'Altava' is not a place name in the gazetteer (needed: Altava, Ouled Mimoun, Algeria, c. 34.88 N 1.05 W). [Reviewer af-02-x: the war 'Garmul's war on the Eastern Romans' (570-578) was removed here because it lies before this state's start (578) and is already in mauro-roman-kingdom's wars.]
